name: [Portal] Recommendations & references data model (DB)
description:
### Summary

The `Professional` detail schema in `partners_web/contract/openapi.yaml` includes up to 3 `recommendations` (testimonial text + name + position + url) and up to 9 `references` (title + logo + url) shown on a partner's profile. Neither has a table in `st_crm`.

### Why?

These are content editors need to maintain per partner (client quotes, case-study logos); without storage they can't be part of "functional data" and would stay hardcoded or blank.

### What?

Two small ordered child tables of `partner`.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `partner_recommendation` (`id`, `partnerId` FK → `partner.id` ON DELETE CASCADE, `text`, `name`, `position` nullable, `url` nullable, `sortOrder`) — app layer enforces max 3 per partner (contract `maxItems: 3`)
- [ ] `partner_reference` (`id`, `partnerId` FK → `partner.id` ON DELETE CASCADE, `title` nullable, `logoUrl` nullable, `url` nullable, `sortOrder`) — app layer enforces max 9 per partner (contract `maxItems: 9`)
- [ ] Migration under `migrations/2026/devrel/crm/CZ3TDR1-673/`, `make lint-migrations` passes

### Resources

- Epic: CZ3TDR1-614
- Depends on: CZ3TDR1-572 (`partner` table)
